Thanks for the ping, Olga. Quick take:
- Pricing: moving from 99.9% to 99.95% monthly increases exposure to credits ~3x under our historical distribution for that profile. For a standard hosted plan I recommend offering a blended approach: 1) a tighter availability rider for primary region (99.95% monthly) with capped monthly credits (X% of monthly invoice, tiered); 2) explicit language that cross-region failover is subject to operational constraints and may require Dedicated or Private for guaranteed RTO.
- Order-form language: propose we supply a paragraph that defines "regional outage" and default behavior (automatic failover to secondary region if capacity available; otherwise we will prioritize stateful KV cache restore). Suggest we avoid hard RTO commitments unless they opt for Dedicated.

I'll draft the credit schedule and sample order-form wording and attach a redwood_orderform-draft.docx. Also estimate a 24–48 hour legal review window. If HealCo insists on monetary credits with no cap, we should escalate to Sales Ops for approval.

I'll attach the draft in the next message.
